## Checked and left as is

- l strings for units 1–3 and 6, and unit 4 l: word-by-word agree with the Geʿez.
- ባልሐ, ሰሐበ, ዐርገ (a-stem), ኮነ, ወለደ, መጽአ, ድኅነ (a-stem), ፈቀረ, ደለወ parses; ኢትፍራህ, ዘይትወለድ, እምኔሃ, ሎቱ, ቦቱ.
- Heading number: ፸፩ = ሰብዓ ወአሐዱ (säbʿa wä-ʾäḥadu) correct.
- `p` flags: units 1 and 2 only (heading; start of the paragraph). No unit over 45 words (longest 23).
- ዘመድ for "kinsman" agrees with ch. 69/70 entries.

## Refused findings

- Retyping or re-splitting any `t` (forbidden). The run-together ሰይጣንወእሞት is kept as printed.
- Changing ተዐውቀ to "was known" in i: the perfect with present force matches the house ተብህለ "it is said"; note now says so.
- Replacing "Sheol" or "mankind"-type house renderings: Sheol is the house form; "humankind" matches l.
- Turning "Joseph" into the genealogical "Jacob/Eli" discussion: outside this part.

These should be aligned with the revised notes.
